W_order_spec_keeps_its_own_lf_only_regex._note: Ratchet site, no work item of its own. Pre-fix a CRLF-fenced order-spec asset was invisible, so the vault's canonical frontmatter ordering was silently not applied to anything `create`/`apply` wrote. Narrow by construction: E2 is the only axis that loads an order spec. ⛤ E3 (the ratchet) reddens under this mutant AND under every other WIRING mutant of this work item, and that was NOT in the first prediction — it was derived from the mutant's THEME rather than from which axes EXECUTE after it lands (integration-test-revert-verify §A44). The reason is structural and is good news: each WIRING mutant re-introduces the literal `/^---\n` into `packages/cli/src`, which is exactly the form E3 asserts is extinct. So E3 is a live ratchet with a demonstrated flip, not a pin — it would be satisfiable by a broken grep otherwise, and its own canary only proves the predicate, not that anything can trip it. ⛤ E2b was in the first prediction and did NOT redden — recorded, not smoothed (§A44). It is the LF CONTROL: this mutant restores an LF-only BLOCK regex, which still sees an LF-fenced spec perfectly, so the control is green BY CONSTRUCTION and would be green under any correct implementation too. Its product is the PAIR with E2 (the CRLF answer equals the LF answer), not a flip of its own.

M_list_continuation_back_to_lf_only._note: The HALF-FIX. Routing this file onto core's predicate makes a CRLF order-spec VISIBLE; without this token it becomes visible and SILENTLY TRUNCATED to its first list item, because `.` never matches a line terminator and a bare `\n?` consumes nothing before a `\r`. Narrow by construction: E2b is the LF control (unaffected) and E3 is the literal ratchet (this mutant introduces no LF-only BLOCK regex, only a list-continuation token, so it does not trip it). ⛤ Found by the review of PR #4463 and NOT by the first E2, whose one-item fixture could not tell truncation from completeness — the axis was widened to the multi-item production shape in the same change, which is what makes this mutant meaningful at all.
